description:
Found while measuring fz-kdt.96's blast radius (2026-08-31).

THE RESIDUAL, measured at d1ccfdea2 and unchanged by fz-kdt.96: under a
full-LIFO agenda flip (`Agenda::pop` -> `pop_back`, src/compiler2/agenda.rs)
the canonical backend dump moves on 5 of 12 measured fixtures --
enum_predicate_search 3169 lines, 00277_enum_tier0_fixture 1813,
enum_map_family 1174, 00183_enum_take_list_range 345,
00420_enum_take_drop_split 12 -- and base+LIFO is BYTE-IDENTICAL to
HEAD+LIFO, so every line of it predates fz-kdt.96.

MECHANISM, proven for the `construction=wN` half (4-6 lines per fixture):
`compare_executable_keys` (jobs/backend.rs:1026) orders the executable
inventory by `activation.inputs(types)` and
`transport_executable_sort_key` (jobs/artifact.rs:1088) orders transport
positions by `activation.arrow` + `input.to_vec()` -- both are RAW Ty
interner ids, assigned in interning order, which the schedule decides. In
00420 the two `Enum.reduce/3[fp[L] list(int), fp[L] empty_list(), fp[F]
closure[Enum.reverse/1#lambda@1563-1599/2]()] need=Value` specializations
print IDENTICAL keys and differ only by Ty id; LIFO swaps their indices
(x39 <-> x40) and the only visible consequence is that their correct,
unchanged construction-wrapper references appear to swap. Instrumented
proof: for FunctionId(74) the wrapper sort keys are Ty(453,530,556,916)
under FIFO and Ty(450,537,554,940) under LIFO -- same types, different
ids, permutable order.

The rest of the movement (renumbered `entry x`/`callee=x` lines, extra
`key ...` specializations, wider/narrower closure unions on value rows)
is a second, larger question: the SPECIALIZATION SET itself differs under
LIFO on 00183/00277/enum_predicate_search. That may be the same id-order
cause reaching type-keyed decisions, or an independent join-order defect.
Not diagnosed here.

BYCATCH, same cause class: four `cargo test --lib` tests fail under the
LIFO flip AT BASE (d1ccfdea2, without fz-kdt.96) --
canon_test::backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_target_fixtures,
drive_test::compiler2_unused_construction_call_binding_keeps_the_root_runnable,
public_trace_test::analysis_claims_survive_a_run_that_could_not_re_derive_them,
public_trace_test::deriving_recursion_from_call_graph_facts_extracts_each_body_once.
The remaining 1514 pass under LIFO.

FIX DIRECTION (named, not built): these orderings want a CANONICAL
comparand, not an id -- the same lesson as the canon dump itself. Order
executables and transport positions by a faithful id-free form of the
activation (the printed/canonical type structure) so two specializations
that are indistinguishable to a reader are also stably ordered, and a
re-ordered pull cannot permute the inventory. Measure against the LIFO
recipe above: the `construction=` half should go to zero first.
title: Executable and construction-wrapper ordering is decided by raw Ty interner ids, so display-identical specializations renumber under a re-ordered pull
